topProcesses.command: python3 import sys sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/BasicSR') sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/Real-ESRGAN') sys.path.insert(0, 'tools') import setuptools, distutils import numpy as np, cv2, time, warnings warnings.filterwarnings('ignore') from basicsr.archs.rrdbnet_arch import RRDBNet from realesrgan import RealESRGANer import keynet_decode as kd from keynet_loader import load_keynet model = RRDBNet(num_in_ch=3, num_out_ch=3, num_feat=64, num_block=23, num_grow_ch=32, scale=4) upsampler = RealESRGANer(scale=4, model_path='/workspace/scratch/models/RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth', model=model, tile=0, tile_pad=10, pre_pad=0, half=False, device='cpu') data = load_keynet() # Test: crop blade region first, then SR only the crop (much smaller input) img = data['obverse'][0] gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY) mask, contours, largest = kd.segment_key(gray) vs, bxs, bxe, bbox, mask = kd.find_blade_region(largest, gray.shape[1]) # Crop with padding pad = 20 x1 = max(0, bbox[0]-pad); y1 = max(0, bbox[1]-pad) x2 = min(img.shape[1], bbox[0]+bbox[2]+pad); y2 = min(img.shape[0], bbox[1]+bbox[3]+pad) crop = img[y1:y2, x1:x2] print(f'Full image: {img.shape}, Crop: {crop.shape}', flush=True) # SR the crop only t0 = time.time() sr_crop, _ = upsampler.enhance(crop, outscale=4) t1 = time.time() print(f'SR crop: {crop.shape} {sr_crop.shape} in {t1-t0:.1f}s', flush=True) # Compare with full image SR time t0 = time.time() sr_full, _ = upsampler.enhance(img, outscale=4) t1 = time.time() print(f'SR full: {img.shape} {sr_full.shape} in {t1-t0:.1f}s', flush=True) print(f'Speedup: {(t1-t0) / ((t1-t0)):.1f}x (crop is {crop.shape[0]*crop.shape[1] / (img.shape[0]*img.shape[1]):.1%} of full)', flush=True) # Try 2x instead of 4x t0 = time.time() sr2, _ = upsampler.enhance(crop, outscale=2) t1 = time.time() print(f'SR crop 2x: {crop.shape} {sr2.shape} in {t1-t0:.1f}s', flush=True)
